name: Aimogen – AI Content Writer, Editor, Chat and Automation
author: CodeRevolution

sections.description:
Aimogen brings AI-powered automation to WordPress. Generate content, auto-create posts, edit articles, summarize text, and connect with OpenAI or other models, all directly inside your WordPress dashboard.

For more information, visit the official Aimogen website

Quick Intro

Hey there! Aimogen was built to make AI content generation simple, accessible, and native to WordPress. AI driven features include: generate posts, rewrite existing posts, summarize articles, or create custom AI-driven chatbots.

The plugin connects directly with OpenAI and other AI providers through your own API key.

If you ever upgrade to Aimogen Pro, you’ll unlock features like automatic post generation from RSS feeds, AI-driven comments, custom templates, fine-tuned writing control and MUCH more. But even Lite gives you a strong start.

Core Features

AI-Powered Content Creation
Generate articles, titles, excerpts, and summaries automatically using AI. Create drafts in seconds and edit them before publishing.

AI Writer in WordPress Editor
Write or improve content directly from the WordPress editor. Generate intros, conclusions, or rewrite entire paragraphs.

Content Rewriter
Transform existing posts into fresh, unique versions. Perfect for updating old content or adapting tone and style.

AI Chatbot
Add a global chatbot to your site, allowing visitors to interact with it in an modern way.

AI Content Generation

Create content with just a few clicks.
Aimogen helps you generate blog posts, headlines, or snippets using modern AI models.

AI Writer

Improve your writing process with AI suggestions built into your workflow.

Capabilities:

Rewrite paragraphs with different tones

Generate introductions or summaries

Suggest SEO-friendly titles

Translate or rephrase content

Content Rewriter

Turn outdated content into new, engaging material.
Aimogen lets you feed existing posts or text and receive rewritten versions in seconds.

Use Cases:

Refresh old articles

Localize or rephrase posts

Maintain consistent tone across your site

Pro Features

Upgrade to Aimogen Pro for:

Automated post generation from RSS feeds

Bulk rewriting and scheduled content creation

AI image generation

AI-driven comments and suggestions

Keyword-based content prompts

Custom templates and advanced settings

Priority updates and support

Why Aimogen?

Native WordPress Integration
No external dashboards or complex setups. Everything happens right in your WP admin.

Flexible & Powerful
Supports multiple AI models and API configurations. You decide how to use it.

Optimized for Real Publishing
Unlike general AI tools, Aimogen is tuned for structured content creation and SEO-aware workflows.

Safe & Transparent
Uses your own API key. No hidden connections, no third-party data collection.

Built for Speed
Lightweight, efficient, and constantly refined for performance.

Disclaimer

Aimogen connects your WordPress site to external AI APIs such as OpenAI. You must use your own API key and follow the terms of the AI service you choose. For OpenAI, review their Terms of Service and Privacy Policy

The plugin developer is not responsible for any damages or misuse of AI-generated content. All data is stored on your server, and it’s your responsibility to keep it secure. Read the full disclaimer here
sections.installation:
Upload aimogen to /wp-content/plugins/

Activate it through the “Plugins” menu

Go to Aimogen → Settings

Add your OpenAI API key (or another provider)

Start generating content right away
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI account?

Yes, Aimogen requires your own API key from OpenAI or a compatible provider.

Can it generate content automatically?

You can generate posts manually. For advanced scheduling, upgrade to Pro.

Does it support multiple languages?

Yes, the AI model can generate and translate content in many languages. Quality may vary depending on the model.

Is Aimogen free forever?

Yes, the Lite version is completely free. You can upgrade anytime for more automation features.

Will it slow down my site?

No. Aimogen is lightweight and only runs on-demand during content generation.

Can I use it with Elementor, Divi, or Gutenberg?

Yes, Aimogen works with all major page builders and editors.
